description: Invented eight-codon ORF; each row has the same 24 reference columns. No viral sequences or resistance catalogue. 'raw' is the submitted record where nextalign stripped an insertion from the aligned row; extra bases sit after codon 2. 'calls' is what is correct, derived by hand from the raw record: the residue of the codon's own raw bases, never a codon an insertion split or a frameshift moved. 'calls_codon2_split' replaces it when the guide carries an insertion inside codon 2, which leaves codon 2 with no single codon to read. STRIPPED_INS_FRAMESHIFT's raw ORF is intact (M K P R V K C *): the aligner's gap at codon 6 pairs with the stripped A after codon 3, so codon 5 is V, not the TAA its columns show.
